name: representative_forming_steel_assumption
source: engineering assumption; not taken from StampFormer
current_baseline_material_card: *MAT_TRANSVERSELY_ANISOTROPIC_ELASTIC_PLASTIC (MAT_037) with normal anisotropy r_bar = 1.575, hardening by load curve
warning: Representative mild deep-drawing steel, in the territory of DC04 / AISI 1006-1008, but NOT calibrated to any specific alloy. Absolute strain magnitudes should be read as representative rather than as data for a named grade. The hardening curve is tabulated to 0.2 plastic strain and extended beyond that by a fitted power law, because a curve that flat-lines at its last point drives premature localisation.
note_on_anisotropy: MAT_037 uses a single normal anisotropy value r_bar. Full planar anisotropy (r0 != r45 != r90, i.e. earing) would need Hill-48 via MAT_036; the individual r-values are kept here for that upgrade.
